title: Chic East w Parking Near Broadway
description:
Peaceful vibes, lush comforts, close proximity to downtown Nashville, Broadway, Nissan Stadium, Music City Center, & the walkable Cleveland Park neighborhood of East Nashville are all yours at our BRAND NEW 1 bdrm/1 bthrm fully private guest house! 

Park your vehicle on our dedicated guest parking pad, enter the unit with our keyless smart lock, and soak up the fresh tranquility as you walk up the indoor stairs and into the fully-stocked kitchen/dining/living + king bedroom w/ en suite bath!

The space
.3 miles walk (5-8 mins) from All People Coffee, Suite 25 Brunch, 

.5 mile walk(10 mins) from Red Headed Stranger, Xiao Bao, Wilburn Street Tavern, Folk, Audrey, June

3 mins drive to Southern Grist Brewery, Lauter, Golden Pony, Flora & Fauna Coffee

6 mins drive to the burgeoning bar and restaurant scene along Gallatin Pike

6 mins drive to 5 Points East Nashville, the nexus of East Nashville and home to many bars and restaurants

10 mins drive to Broadway, Nissan Stadium, Music City Center, Bridgestone Arena, Ryman Auditorium and all of downtown Nashville!

*BRAND NEW fully private guest house in East Nashville 
*Walkable neighborhood
*Restaurants, Shops within walking distance!
*FREE gourmet coffee starter pack provided by Humphreys Street Coffee!
*10 mins drive (2 miles) to Broadway, Music City Center, Bridgestone Arena, Nissan Stadium
*12 mins drive from Nashville International Airport
*PRIVATE PARKING PAD
*High speed WiFi!
*NEW furnishings and thoughtful interior design
*Remote controlled AC/Heat mini-split system in each room
*Plush memory foam KING SIZED bed
*Fully stocked gourmet kitchen
*4 burner range with hood and exhaust fan
*5 cup drip coffee maker
*Dishwasher, Stove, Refrigerator, Freezer
*High-end local Humphreys Street coffee provided!
*Cookware, dishes, utensils, baking sheets, kettle
*TV in bedroom
*Iron & Ironing Board
*Shampoo, Conditioner, Body Wash
*Hairdryer
*Huge walk in shower 
*Hotel luxury sheets, towels, and linens
*High end furnishings 
*Hardwood floors throughout
*Plush futon style couch for additional sleeping
*Private entrance 
*Everything is BRAND NEW!
*Responsive host
*Perfect for couples getaway!
*Uber, Lyft readily available!

Guest access
Guests will have full use of the parking pad and apartment! The homeowner of the main house uses the garage below the apartment for parking.

Other things to note
The homeowner of the main house uses the garage below the apartment for parking.

We have an exterior camera on the house near the door.
